STK310 Statistical Inference - Final exam, spring 2024
Time: 4 hours. Allowed aids: one A4 sheet of notes, a simple calculator.
Question 1 (10 points)
Let X1, ..., Xn be independent and Poisson distributed with mean lambda.
a) Show that T = X1 + ... + Xn is a sufficient statistic for lambda.
b) Find the maximum likelihood estimator of lambda.
Question 2 (8 points)
Explain the difference between a confidence interval and a credible interval.
Question 3 (12 points)
The figure below shows the posterior density for three sample sizes.
Describe how the posterior changes as n grows, and why.
